name: Rust Tiger
description: Burnt orange and umber cut through long, sweeping bands of soot black.

name: Frost Splinter
description: A white winter ground broken by slate fragments and fine, interrupted rain marks.

name: Quarry
description: Broad limestone and dusty sage shapes meet in hard, angular seams.

name: Black Ice
description: Bands of graphite, petrol teal and silver intersect at abrupt angles.

name: Bruise
description: Aubergine, plum and smoke give the rounded contours a subdued purple cast.

name: Dune Chip
description: Pale and dark flecks sit on broad sand and clay shapes, a nod to the six-color desert uniform.

name: Birch Leaf
description: Small, pale leaf-shaped islands interrupt a forest-green field. Inspired by the two-tone Berezka coverall.

name: Ember Leaf
description: Overlapping oak-leaf flecks in ochre, brick and maroon bring an autumn print into a warmer palette.

name: Tidal Pixel
description: Stepped clusters in slate, navy and turquoise take the digital pattern family into coastal colors.
